features.name: sealed puzzle chambers
features.notes: Fully enclosed rooms holding players until puzzle criteria are met
features.quote: "Sealed Chambers: Fully enclosed rooms that physically hold the player until the logic criteria are met."

features.name: distinct themed floor interiors
features.notes: One visually distinct room theme per floor
features.quote: "三层不同主题、不同机制的房间"

features.name: interfloor stairways or elevators
features.notes: Connections from floor 1 to 2 and floor 2 to 3
features.quote: "开启通往下一层的电梯 / 楼梯"

features.name: reachable puzzle input devices
features.notes: Levers keypads or pressure plates placed within player reach
features.quote: "Levers, keypads, and pressure plates mounted where players can reach them."

features.name: clue facade walls
features.notes: Directly along natural player camera paths with visible riddle pattern or hint
features.quote: "A feature wall placed directly in the player's natural camera path, hosting a riddle, pattern, or hint."

features.name: sequenced unlock barriers
features.notes: Barriers separating later areas until earlier puzzle completion
features.quote: "A barrier that opens only once an earlier puzzle in the chain is complete."

features.name: third floor top exit
features.quote: "到达第 3 层顶部出口即通关"
